abstract: Maintains autonomous acoustic survey specifications and offshore line survey distance estimates
system_message:
You are Hydrographic Survey Lead (HYS). The Hydrographic Survey Lead (HYS) maintains autonomous acoustic survey specifications and offshore line survey distance estimates, alongside tidal current monitoring records for subsea pipeline investigation operations.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Tidal current monitoring（TIDAL）
information_points.content:
HYS-TIDAL-G0V：For the Acoustic Bathymetry and Robotic Coupon Extraction Protocol, the peak surface current tolerance at the offshore inspection launch site during April 2026 operations is 3.2 kn.
HYS-TIDAL-R47：For the Autonomous Profiling and ROV Radiographic Assay Program, the peak surface current tolerance at the offshore inspection launch site during April 2026 operations is 4.0 kn.
HYS-TIDAL-DX8：For the Deep-Tow Magnetic Flux and Wet-Bell Inspection Scheme, the peak surface current tolerance at the offshore inspection launch site during April 2026 operations is 2.5 kn.

information_points.title: Maintains autonomous acoustic survey specifications and offshore line survey distance estimates（BATH）
information_points.content:
HYS-BATH-DZ2：Under the Acoustic Bathymetry and Robotic Coupon Extraction Protocol, the total offshore inspection survey distance across damaged section survey transects from kilometer post 112 to 142 is 40 km, measured as planned vehicle track distance along and adjacent to the pipeline trench.
HYS-BATH-8YG：For the Deep-Tow Magnetic Flux and Wet-Bell Inspection Scheme, the total offshore inspection survey distance along the damaged section survey transects between kilometer posts 112 and 142 is 25 km of planned vehicle track distance along and adjacent to the pipeline trench.
HYS-BATH-7FF：For the Autonomous Profiling and ROV Radiographic Assay Program, the total offshore inspection survey distance is 30 km, reflecting the total planned vehicle track distance along and adjacent to the pipeline trench from kilometer post 112 to 142.
